FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa0: Disables system language options, preventing changes to system language and localization settings.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa1: Disables app suggestions and recommendations, avoiding pop-ups and advice from applications.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa2: Disables telemetry data collection and submission, protecting user privacy by limiting data sent to Microsoft.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa3: Disables user activity tracking by the system, avoiding the logging of user behavior and actions.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa4: Disables automatic error and bug reporting, preventing error data from being sent to Microsoft.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa5: Disables diagnostic tracking of performance and errors in the OS, preventing reports from being sent.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa6: Disables WAP Push messaging service, stopping push notification delivery through this service.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa7: Disables HomeGroup functionality, blocking creation and management of network homegroups.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa8: Disables remote assistance, preventing others from remotely connecting to your PC for support.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa9: Disables scheduled disk defragmentation, preventing automatic file defragmentation.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa10: Disables Xbox-related features such as data sync and Xbox account apps.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa11: Disables automatic maintenance tasks like disk cleanup and security checks.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa12: Disables reserved storage management, stopping OS from allocating space for updates and temp files.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa13: Disables Game DVR performance enhancements, avoiding automatic game recordings and optimizations.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa14: Disables activity history, stopping recording and display of previous actions like clipboard and opened items.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa15: Disables WiFi Sense, preventing automatic connection to public Wi-Fi and sharing with contacts.
FormPrivacy.tooltipDisa16: Disables the notification bar and calendar, hiding system notifications and calendar info.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil0: Enables language and regional options in the system, allowing changes to system language and localization settings.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil1: Enables app suggestions and recommendations, showing notifications and tips from applications.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil2: Enables telemetry data collection and submission, helping improve the OS and Microsoft products.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil3: Enables user activity tracking, logging actions and behaviors within the system.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil4: Enables automatic error and bug reporting, sending reports to Microsoft for improvements.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil5: Enables diagnostic tracking of performance and errors, allowing the collection of diagnostic data.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil6: Enables WAP Push messaging service, allowing the sending and receiving of push notifications.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil7: Enables HomeGroup functionality, allowing creation and management of home groups for sharing files and devices over the network.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil8: Enables remote assistance, allowing others to connect to the computer for technical support via remote desktop.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil9: Enables scheduling and automatic execution of disk defragmentation, allowing automatic file defrag.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil10: Enables Xbox features, such as data synchronization and apps related to the Xbox account on the computer.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil11: Enables automatic maintenance, allowing the system to perform tasks like disk cleanup and security checks automatically.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil12: Enables reserved storage management, allowing the OS to automatically allocate space for temporary files and updates.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil13: Enables gaming performance enhancements via Game DVR, allowing automatic game recording and related optimizations.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil14: Enables activity history, allowing the recording and viewing of previous actions like clipboard and opened items.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil15: Enables WiFi Sense, allowing automatic connection to public Wi-Fi and sharing networks with Microsoft contacts.
FormPrivacy.tooltipAbil16: Enables the notification bar and calendar, showing system notifications and calendar information.

FormDefender.desc0: Disables Controlled Folder Access, a security feature that protects files from unauthorized changes. Disabling it removes this protection.
FormDefender.desc1: Disables Core Isolation, a feature that protects the system from sophisticated attacks by isolating critical processes. Not recommended to disable unless necessary.
FormDefender.desc2: Disables Defender Application Guard, a security feature that isolates the browser for safer browsing.
FormDefender.desc3: Disables Account Protection Warnings, which notify you of missing security functionalities.
FormDefender.desc4: Disables downloaded file blocking, avoiding the application of the 'Mark of the Web' flag used by Windows to signal potential risks.
FormDefender.desc5: Disables Windows Script Host, preventing VBScript or JScript execution, useful to block potentially dangerous scripts.
FormDefender.desc6: Disables strong .NET encryption, forcing the use of weaker algorithms, usually for compatibility with legacy software.
FormDefender.desc7: Sets the minimum level of User Account Control (UAC), reducing user account notifications. May reduce security.
FormDefender.desc8: Disables automatic administrative shares creation (like C$, ADMIN$), used for remote system management.
FormDefender.desc9: Disables Windows Firewall, removing built-in protection against unauthorized network traffic.
FormDefender.desc10: Disables Windows Defender cloud integration, which sends data to Microsoft to improve malware detection.
FormDefender.desc11: Hides the Windows Defender icon in the system tray without disabling the service.
FormDefender.desc12: Completely disables Windows Defender services, removing real-time antivirus protection.
FormDefender.abil0: Enables Controlled Folder Access, protecting files from unauthorized changes by unknown apps.
FormDefender.abil1: Enables Core Isolation, enhancing system security by isolating critical processes from sophisticated threats.
FormDefender.abil2: Enables Defender Application Guard, allowing the browser to run in an isolated environment for safer browsing.
FormDefender.abil3: Enables Account Protection Warning notifications, which alert you about missing security components.
FormDefender.abil4: Enables blocking of downloaded files, applying the 'Mark of the Web' to flag files from the internet as potentially risky.
FormDefender.abil5: Enables Windows Script Host, allowing the execution of VBScript and JScript. Useful for admin tools and automation scripts.
FormDefender.abil6: Enables strong .NET cryptography, improving data processing and communication security.
FormDefender.abil7: Sets the highest UAC (User Account Control) level, providing maximum control over system changes.
FormDefender.abil8: Enables creation of administrative shares (like C$, ADMIN$), useful for remote management over a network.
FormDefender.abil9: Enables Windows Firewall, protecting the system from unwanted or potentially harmful network traffic.
FormDefender.abil10: Enables cloud integration for Windows Defender, helping detect new threats quickly using Microsoft AI.
FormDefender.abil11: Enables the Windows Defender icon in the system tray, making it easier to monitor protection status.
FormDefender.abil12: Enables all Windows Defender services, ensuring real-time antivirus protection against threats.

FormUpdate.tooltipDisabilita_0: Disables automatic downloading of Windows updates, preventing the system from downloading and installing updates without authorization.
FormUpdate.tooltipDisabilita_1: Disables automatic updating of Microsoft products via Windows Update (e.g., Office), limiting updates to Windows only.
FormUpdate.tooltipDisabilita_2: Disables automatic driver downloads through Windows Update, useful for those who prefer manual driver management.
FormUpdate.tooltipDisabilita_3: Disables automatic system restart after updates, avoiding unexpected interruptions.
FormUpdate.tooltipDisabilita_4: Disables notifications related to Windows updates, hiding alerts about new updates.
FormUpdate.tooltipAbilita_0: Enables automatic downloading of Windows updates, ensuring the system stays up-to-date with the latest security patches.
FormUpdate.tooltipAbilita_1: Enables automatic updates for Microsoft products (e.g., Office) via Windows Update.
FormUpdate.tooltipAbilita_2: Enables automatic driver downloads via Windows Update, keeping hardware drivers up to date.
FormUpdate.tooltipAbilita_3: Enables automatic system restart after installing updates, ensuring changes are applied properly.
FormUpdate.tooltipAbilita_4: Enables update notifications, informing the user about the availability of new updates.
